chunks: Whatever is in it from Ishaq ibn Ammar, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from Ali ibn Isma'il, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ishaq ibn Ammar.

key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: A nisbah identifying Abdullah ibn Ja'far as al-Himyari.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: An honorific supplication meaning 'may Allah be pleased with him.'
key_terms.عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ: A transmission route leading back to Ishaq ibn Ammar as the source narrator.
key_terms.فَقَدْ رَوَيْتُهُ: Indicates that the author is explicitly stating his own mode of transmission.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ishaq ibn Ammar in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Ishaq ibn Ammar in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the route of transmission and preserving the hadith’s scholarly chain of authority.
